visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a 2D animation featuring two stylized cats on a plain white background. A white cat with minimalist features is seen from the side, embracing a larger orange-striped cat. The orange cat is crying exaggeratedly, with its mouth wide open in a large 'D' shape and thick white tears streaming down its face. The lighting is perfectly flat with no shadows, consistent with modern graphic design. (2) The scene maintains its focus on the two characters in their supportive hugging posture. The orange cat's body slightly pulses to indicate sobbing, while the white cat remains still and comforting. The background environment is completely devoid of objects, focusing entirely on the interaction between the two animated characters and the bold black text appearing above them. (3) The camera performs a digital zoom into the mid-section of the orange cat. A green stack of banknotes, bound by a paper strap and marked with a dollar sign, suddenly appears inside a small pocket on the cat's belly. The white cat's paws are still visible on the side of the orange cat's torso, while the upper part of the crying face is partially cropped by the closer framing.
